description: Defines the TaskList class which manages a collection of Task objects, providing CRUD operations, filtering, searching, and state management for a task management application.

classes.name: TaskList
classes.description: Class that manages a collection of Tasks with operations such as create, update, delete, toggle completion, move, and filter.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a const reference to all Tasks.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Returns a vector of Tasks filtered by the given filter and search string.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new Task with the specified title, description, and due date.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing Task if it exists.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a Task identified by id.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the Task with the specified id.

methods.name: moveUp
methods.description: Moves the Task with the specified id up in the list.

methods.name: moveDown
methods.description: Moves the Task with the specified id down in the list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all Tasks from the list.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Replaces the current task list with the provided list, intended for persistence.

methods.name: validateTitle
methods.description: Static method that validates the Task title (e.g., trims, checks for non-emptiness and length).

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a Task with the given id within the internal vector.
